weighting: Equal scenario mass after paired exclusions, weighted mid-CDF ranks and weighted Pearson correlation; user confirmed 2026-10-15
primary_domain: Require all seven scenarios with at least three valid paired landscapes; no silent scenario removal
empirical_example_rule: Most frequent best_parameter_id across all 15 checked Result-C bird matches; ties resolved by parameter_id; display only, no biological calibration or new fitting

bootstrap.resampling: Independent size-eight shared1-8 and directed-only9-16 seed cohorts; paired H, scenarios, metrics and parameter profiles remain together
bootstrap.interval: 95% pointwise percentile intervals, linear quantiles; freeze first stable batch, withhold nonconverged intervals

scope: Conditional associations under an equal seven-scenario mixture; no control for scenario membership, no causal or out-of-sample predictive claim; capacity comparison omitted as optional
